headlines.text: Back on this day in 2025, Mascara Dorada vs. Hechicero met in a Tournament Match, serving as the night's main event on Collision, rated 7.70 ? a good, competitive contest.
On this day in 2023, Lucha Brothers & Bandido made their first appearance under the AEW banner as a team, appearing on Dynamite, rated 7.61 ? a match that delivered.
Flash back to 2024, when Viva Van competed under the AEW banner for the first time against Toni Storm, appearing on Rampage, rated 5.64.

secondaries.text: Rewind to 2025, when Dante Martin reached a milestone worth celebrating: their 100th match in AEW, facing LFI (Dralistico, Mortos & Rush) vs. Top Flight & Fox on Collision, rated 6.76 in a wild trios sprint.
Back on this day in 2025, it was Paragon & Ishii's first night in AEW as a team, appearing on Collision, rated 7.03 ? a well-worked match.
Turning the clock back to 2023: Kris Statlander made their long-awaited comeback after just under 12 months away, appearing on Dynamite.
